unrelated_user_work: present; neither stopped nor included in descendant RSS
publication_network: offline installed dependencies and maintained pinned inputs
native_refresh_transport: captured public GET fixtures and real owned local R2, no live network/edge purge
tree_RSS: 50ms sampled descendants within the same command window; excludes unrelated processes; sampled maximum may miss brief peaks
individual_RSS: GNU time maximum individual process/phase, not a sum
